meta.title: AskDB — ask your database in plain language
meta.description: Ask questions about a PostgreSQL database in Arabic or English and get a table, a chart, and a short summary.

home.title: Ask your database in plain language
home.subtitle: Type a question in Arabic or English. Get back a table, a chart, and a short summary in seconds — no SQL needed.

auth.title: Sign in to AskDB
auth.subtitle: Use your GitHub account, or look around first with a guest account on sample data.
auth.guestNote: Guest accounts use the Northwind sample database and are deleted after 7 days.

ask.title: Ask a question
